title: Oswald's Fair Play for Cuba leaflets carry Banister's Camp Street address

tellings.quote: the Fair Play for Cuba leaflets that Lee Harvey Oswald was passing out had the address of Camp Street, the same address.

plain: The leaflets Lee Harvey Oswald handed out in New Orleans in 1963 for Fair Play for Cuba, a group supporting Castro's Cuba, carried the address 544 Camp Street, which according to the author Peter Levenda was the same address as the office of Guy Banister, a former FBI man. Levenda tells Michels this without naming a source, though he points to the leaflets themselves. It matters because it would tie Oswald's supposedly pro-Cuba activity to a man on the opposite side of politics.
